title: More Than Mimicking Reviewers: Evaluating LLMs for Pre-Submission Peer Review
abstract: arXiv:2609.05788v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Peer-review feedback often arrives too late for authors to make meaningful revisions. We study an author-facing LLM system that moves part of this stress test before submission: it generates a broad pool of atomic concerns and compresses them into a short report. We evaluate agreement with historical reviews and, separately, the possible validity of concerns they omit.   From 10,000 ICLR 2026 submissions, we use 3,398 manuscripts with accessible versions that predate review. On a ten-paper diagnostic, independent sampling covers 44.9% of historical issues; deduplication and refill reaches 78.7% strict and 84.9% seriousness-weighted coverage, at 3.6$\times$ more requests and 5.2$\times$ more tokens. A hidden Top-32 Oracle preserves the full 79.3% weighted coverage of a 256-candidate pool, but paper-only selectors retain only 40--44%. LLM review therefore provides broad coverage with a large candidate pool but compresses poorly; ablations

translated_title: 不仅仅是模仿审稿人：评估大语言模型在投稿前同行评审中的应用
translated_abstract: 同行评审的反馈往往来得太晚，以至于作者无法据此进行有意义的修改。我们研究了一个面向作者的大语言模型系统，它将这种压力测试的一部分提前到投稿之前：该系统生成一个广泛的原子化问题池，并将其压缩为一份简短报告。我们评估了该系统与历史评审意见的一致性，并单独评估了其所遗漏问题的可能有效性。从10,000份ICLR 2026投稿中，我们使用了3,398份可获取评审前版本的手稿。在一项十篇论文的诊断测试中，独立采样覆盖了44.9%的历史问题；通过去重和补充，严格覆盖率达到78.7%，按严重程度加权覆盖率达到84.9%，代价是请求数量增加3.6倍、令牌消耗增加5.2倍。一个隐藏的Top-32 Oracle能够保持256个候选池完整的79.3%加权覆盖率，但仅基于论文的选择器只能保留40-44%的覆盖率。因此，大语言模型评审虽然能凭借庞大的候选池提供广泛的覆盖，但压缩效果不佳；消融实验
tldr: 该研究提出了一个面向作者的大语言模型投稿前评审系统，通过生成并压缩大量原子化审稿问题，实现对历史审稿意见78.7%的高覆盖率，同时发现大候选池虽覆盖广泛但自动压缩选择效果不佳。
en_tdlr: This study proposes an author-facing LLM pre-submission review system that generates and compresses a large pool of atomic concerns, achieving 78.7% coverage of historical review issues, while revealing that large candidate pools provide broad coverage but paper-only compression selectors perform poorly.
